title: Witch on the Yellow Brick Road
description: A pink-haired witch in black and green armor stands on a glowing yellow brick road, swinging a large hammer labeled "IMPACT" that emits purple lightning. Behind her, two smaller witches walk toward a towering, spiraling fantasy city built around a massive glowing tree under a starry night sky with crescent moons.
prompt: A dynamic digital painting of a fierce pink-haired female witch wearing black and green armored outfit, standing on a glowing cracked yellow brick road. She swings a large black hammer crackling with purple lightning that says IMPACT. In the background, two smaller witches walk the winding path toward a massive glowing fantasy city built into a giant spiraling tree with lights and flowers. Night sky with crescent moons and purple magical swirls, vibrant colors, dramatic fantasy style.
